evidence_items.explanation: The census documents workforce constraints amid shortages. It does not attribute job losses to AI or count radiologists replaced by AI, so it cannot settle the forecast.
The paper discusses autonomous reporting as a possible way to reduce workload. It reports neither a count of displaced radiologists nor a comprehensive finding that no displacement occurred.

unresolved_gaps: No sufficiently broad count of actual AI-caused radiologist replacement during 2025 was found.
Available workforce evidence does not distinguish gross AI displacement from hiring freezes, retirement or other departures.
UK evidence alone cannot establish the geographically unrestricted claim.
